evidence.detail: Exact v308 builds root widget 31244 and preserves the literal title '@or1@Item Enchantment Chest'.
The builder owns exact Enchantments, Item name, Categories, Enchant, Attempt Enchantment, Success chance, Ingredients, Select enchantment, Select item, category-selection and item-search controls.

The same class owns the active enchantment presentation state and exact strings 'Preparing enchantment..', 'Success! Congratulations!' and 'Enchantment failed!', plus the corresponding fountain sprites.
The class is constructed by the central interface registry and owns the complete 3124x/4999x item-enchantment widget surface without unrelated subsystem behavior.

candidates.note: Name follows the exact visible Item Enchantment Chest title and distinguishes this complete chest/search/result interface from generic enchantment terminology.
